integrity: The source vertex realization was checked directly. The proof derives a positive barycentric formula for the proposed center using the simple-root path, computes every vertex distance exactly as a function of the tournament gap, and uses the contact barycenter identity to prove global minimality and uniqueness. The finite nonlinear-optimization replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard incidence-vector realization of the transitive tournament directed edge polytope. It does not determine minimum enclosing spheres for arbitrary tournaments or arbitrary acyclic quivers, and the Euclidean formulas are not affine invariants.
title: Simple roots control the minimum sphere of transitive-tournament directed edge polytopes
